PROVENANCE OF EVERY URL IN THIS BATCH - NO URL HERE IS A GUESSED SHAPE (METHODOLOGY Part VIII). Rows 1-3: https://www.italaw.com/investment-treaties/nafta - returned by S5 result 6 and again by S6 result 1. Rows 4-5: https://www.italaw.com/investment-treaties - returned by S5 result 1. Row 9: the closing bracket control, distinct from the control the runner prepends. THE ANALYST'S PRIOR, STATED BEFORE THE ROWS RETURN AND AGAINST ITS OWN INTEREST. At www.italaw.com, across all 70 committed reductions in analytics/fetch-results/ at commit 256cb6e, this relay holds 12 rows: 4 ok/200, every one application/pdf with excerpt length 0, every one under /sites/default/files/case-documents/; and 8 refused/403 covering the bare site root https://www.italaw.com/ (2026-08-03), /cases/8154 (three rows), /cases/documents/10912 (two rows) and /cases/11573 (two rows, 2026-09-12). EIGHT OF EIGHT NON-PDF ROWS EVER FIRED AT THIS HOST HAVE BEEN REFUSED, THE SITE ROOT AMONG THEM. THE ANALYST THEREFORE EXPECTS ROWS 1-6 TO REFUSE AND EXPECTS ROWS 7-8 TO ANSWER. If that is how it falls, this batch does NOT close the gap and the analyst will say so. The one thing that makes rows 1-6 worth firing at all rather than zero rows: /investment-treaties/ is a path shape never tried at this host, and italaw's refusals are already known to be path-discriminating within a single run, client held constant (analytics/insights.jsonl:73, 2026-08-18) - so a host-wide reading is not available to any seat. NOT DISCOVERY, AND THE ANALYST EXPECTS TO BE CHECKED ON THIS. Every URL above was IDENTIFIED BY A SOURCE before it was requested: rows 1-5 and 7 by search returns recorded in analytics/search-results/2026-09-21.json with call and result index; row 8 by this project's own committed search artefact of 2026-09-20; row 6 by this project's own committed research record since 2026-06-26. NO URL IN THIS BATCH WAS CONSTRUCTED BY SLUG ANALOGY, PATTERN OR GUESS. The 2026-08-05 seat refused to construct italaw.com/investment-treaties/china-switzerland-bit-2009 by analogy and was right to; this batch does not do that, and china-switzerland-bit-2009 is not in it. CONCENTRATION RISK, DECLARED. All eight substantive rows are at ONE host. That is not a design preference; it is the honest consequence of six searches finding no non-PDF NAFTA Chapter Eleven candidate at any other allowlisted host. If www.italaw.com refuses everything, this batch returns no information about any resource, and that outcome is pre-registered here as a real and reasonably likely one. WHAT EACH ROW MEANS, PRE-REGISTERED PER OUTCOME CLASS AND NEVER PER DOCUMENT (2026-09-20 next step 4). content_type and bytes are recorded whatever the body is; A REFUSAL HAS NO BODY TO TYPE and its content_type and bytes are null for that reason and for no other. GROUP A = rows 1-3, the NAFTA-titled page, find "" / "1110" / "Chapter Eleven". (A-ok, html or text content type, row 1 excerpt non-empty) establishes that an allowlisted host serves visible prose at a NAFTA-titled locator, and nothing more than that. Row 2 non-empty establishes that the substring 1110 occurs in that page's visible prose; row 3 non-empty establishes that the substring "chapter eleven" does, case-insensitively. NONE OF THE THREE, SEPARATELY OR TOGETHER, ESTABLISHES THAT THE PAGE CARRIES THE TEXT OF NAFTA CHAPTER ELEVEN: a case-history profile page can carry both substrings without carrying one word of the treaty, and this batch cannot tell those apart. (A-ok, content type neither html nor text) rows 2 and 3 return the empty string BY CONSTRUCTION regardless of what the page contains (scripts/fetch_relay.py:124-125), and row 1's empty excerpt is then NOT evidence of an empty page. (A-ok, html, row 1 non-empty, row 2 or 3 empty) licenses the full taxonomy-38 form for that string: it occurs nowhere in that page's visible prose, in any case, as any part of any word - because excerpt_of applies body.lower().find(find.lower()) to tag-stripped text. It licenses NOTHING about markup, attributes or script bodies, which the tag-strip removes first. (A-refused) A TOOL-LAYER OUTCOME. It licenses nothing whatever about what is served at that URL, and in particular does not license any sentence of the form "italaw does not serve NAFTA". (A-robots_disallowed) our own client declined before asking; the origin was never contacted; this records nothing about the resource and is not a refusal (src/sources/base.py:339 keeps the two distinct; analytics/insights.jsonl:167). (A-no_contact) transport failure at our end; same bar. GROUP B = rows 4-5, the index page, find "" / "NAFTA". Same outcome-class readings as Group A. Its separate job is discrimination: if A refuses and B answers, the refusal is specific below /investment-treaties/; if both refuse, the whole /investment-treaties/ shape refuses this relay at this timestamp; if both answer, the shape answers. GROUP C = row 6, the China-Germany BIT slug of the SAME /investment-treaties/<slug> shape as rows 1-5, find "". THIS IS THE CONTROL THAT MAKES ROWS 1-5 INTERPRETABLE, and it is the row the analyst would keep if it could keep only one. Rows 1-5 come from a search engine's index; row 6 comes from this project's own committed record. Together they separate SLUG from SHAPE inside one run, one client, one user agent. (C-ok and A/B ok) the /investment-treaties/<slug> shape answers this relay, and the NAFTA slug is not special. (C-ok and A/B refused) the shape answers and the refusal is specific to the slugs tried; that would be a strong and surprising result and the analyst pre-commits that it would run against its own stated prior. (C-refused and A/B refused) the shape refuses this relay at this timestamp. It does NOT establish that the shape refuses in general, that italaw refuses, or anything about what is served there. (C-robots_disallowed) our client declined before asking and the shape was never tested at the origin; rows 1-5 are then uncontrolled and must be read as such. WHAT ROW 6 SETTLES THAT NOTHING ELSE IN THIS BATCH DOES, AND IT IS AGAINST THIS COUNCIL: on 2026-08-05 a seat wrote that "www.italaw.com is allowlisted, and the record proves italaw hosts treaty-text pages for at least one China BIT" (analytics/daily-research/2026-08-05.md:205) and then declined to CONSTRUCT a sibling URL by slug analogy, correctly, because that is discovery. IT DID NOT FIRE THE URL THE RECORD ALREADY HELD. Nobody has, in the 47 days since. Row 6 is that row, 47 days late. STATED SO IT IS NOT OVERREAD: no seat of this council has ever RETRIEVED that page; the 2026-06-26 entry that carries the URL describes the direct treaty PDF as "not directly readable (403)"; what the record holds is a LOCATOR, and the characterisation of it as a treaty-text page is a seat's, not a retrieval. GROUP D = rows 7-8, two PDF-suffixed locators under /sites/default/files/laws/, a sub-path never tried, both find "". THESE ROWS CANNOT CLOSE THE GAP AND ARE NOT OFFERED AS CLOSING IT: excerpt_of returns the empty string for every content type that is neither html nor text, so a PDF locator yields an empty excerpt however rich the document is. (D-ok on both) compare content_type, bytes and sha256. Yesterday's artefact and today's carry the IDENTICAL eleven-word engine title "NORTH AMERICAN FREE TRADE AGREEMENT _______________ TABLE OF CONTENTS Preamble" on three distinct URLs across two hosts (investmentpolicy.unctad.org treaty-files/2412; italaw6187(6).pdf; italaw6187(14).pdf). If bytes or sha256 DIFFER, two distinct files carry one identical engine title. If they are IDENTICAL, one byte-stream is served at two paths. ON EITHER BRANCH THE ENGINE TITLE DOES NOT INDIVIDUATE THE FILE, which bears directly on escalation 2, whose candidate at UNCTAD 2412 is banked on exactly that title. NEITHER BRANCH IDENTIFIES ANY OF THESE FILES AS NAFTA: nothing retrieved carries that, and adjacency, title-sharing and directory-sharing are not identity. (D-ok, content type html or text) would establish that a .pdf suffix does not imply a PDF body at this host, and rows 7-8 would then bear on the gap after all. (D-refused / robots_disallowed / no_contact) establishes only that this relay was refused or never connected at that sub-path at that timestamp. ROW 9 = THE CLOSING BRACKET, https://example.com/ with find "Example Domain", deliberately distinct from the row the runner prepends. The prepended row is fired with no find and therefore proves REACHABILITY ONLY. Row 9 proves THE FIND PATH EXECUTED END TO END IN THIS RUN. (9-ok with find_matched true) every empty excerpt elsewhere in this batch is interpretable as an absence rather than as a broken instrument. (9-ok with find_matched false) the find path did not execute and EVERY empty excerpt in this batch is uninterpretable; the batch must then be read as void on that axis whatever the other rows say. PAIRING DISCIPLINE, SATISFIED AND CHECKABLE: every row carrying a non-empty find has a companion row on the SAME url in the SAME run with find "". Row 2 and row 3 are companioned by row 1; row 5 is companioned by row 4. Rows 6, 7 and 8 already carry find "" and need no companion. Row 9's companion is the runner's own prepended control on the same url. IF control_ok IS FALSE the runner marks every row not_attempted and NO ROW IN THIS BATCH MAY BE READ AS INFORMATION ABOUT ITS RESOURCE, including the rows that look like answers. ON THE GAP'S CLOSURE CONDITION, RECORDED BEFORE FIRING AND NOT RE-NEGOTIATED. The chairman fixed it as "one ok row with a non-empty excerpt at any allowlisted locator". Read literally that condition is already satisfied by 134 ok rows with non-empty excerpts at https://example.com/, which is on ALLOWED_HOSTS (scripts/fetch_relay.py:67-68, marked "Neutral control only - never a research source"), so the literal reading cannot be the intended one. The analyst therefore acts on the reading the gap's own slug requires - an ok row with a non-empty excerpt at an allowlisted locator THAT SERVES NAFTA CHAPTER ELEVEN. Under that reading the ONLY rows in this batch that could close the gap are rows 1-3, and even they close it only if the page they name turns out to carry the chapter's text rather than a case history, WHICH THIS BATCH CANNOT DETERMINE. Rows 4-5 name an index page, row 6 names a different treaty, rows 7-8 are PDF-suffixed and row 9 is a control; none of those five could close it on any reading. THE ANALYST DOES NOT AMEND THE CONDITION. It records the ambiguity before firing so that whoever grades this batch grades it against a stated reading rather than picking one afterwards. NOTHING IN THIS BATCH CAN ESTABLISH ANYTHING ABOUT WHAT NAFTA ARTICLE 1110 SAYS, WHETHER A PARAGRAPH (7) EXISTS, OR WHETHER ANY IP-SPECIFIC INTERNAL LIMITATION IS CARRIED ANYWHERE. No treaty text has been read by any seat of this council. Escalation 2 remains an ask of the operator whatever these nine rows do.
